        for c in range(cols):
            if grid[r][c] != bg:
                color_positions[grid[r][c]].append((r, c))
    
    for color, positions in color_positions.items():
        n = len(positions)
        for i in range(n):
            r1, c1 = positions[i]
            for j in range(i + 1, n):
                r2, c2 = positions[j]
                # Check diagonal adjacency
                if abs(r1 - r2) == 1 and abs(c1 - c2) == 1:
                    # Extend from r1 in direction of r1-r2 (away from r2)
                    dr, dc = r1 - r2, c1 - c2
                    curr_r, curr_c = r1, c1
                    while True:
                        nr, nc = curr_r + dr, curr_c + dc
                        if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols:
                            val = grid[nr][nc]
                            if val != color and val != bg:

                            result[nr][nc] = color

                            if val != color and val != bg:

                            result[nr][nc] = color
                            curr_r, curr_c = nr, nc

    return result

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    if not grid:
        return grid
    # Identify background color
    flat_pixels = [pixel for row in grid for pixel in row]
    bg = Counter(flat_pixels).most_common(1)[0][0]
    
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])
    result = [row[:] for row in grid]
    
    # Group positions by color (excluding background)
    color_positions = Counter()
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            val = grid[r][c]
            if val != bg:
                color_positions[val].append((r, c))
    
    # For each color, extend diagonal connections
    for color, positions in color_positions.items():
        n = len(positions)
        for i in range(n):
            r1, c1 = positions[i]
            for j in range(i + 1, n):
                r2, c2 = positions[j]
                # Check for diagonal adjacency
                if abs(r1 - r2) == 1 and abs(c1 - c2) == 1:
                    # Direction from 1 to 2 (for extending from 1 away from 2)
                    d_r, d_c = r1 - r2, c1 - c2
                    curr_r, curr_c = r1, c1
                    while True:
                        next_r = curr_r + d_r
                        next_c = curr_c + d_c
                        if 0 <= next_r < rows and 0 <= next_c < cols:
                            cell_val = grid[next_r][next_c]
                            if cell_val != color and cell_val != bg:
                                break
                            result[next_r][next_c] = color
                            curr_r, curr_c = next_r, next_c
                        else:
                            break
                    
                    # Direction from 2 to 1 (for extending from 2 away from 1)
                    d_r, d_c = r2 - r1, c2 - c1
                    curr_r, curr_c = r2, c2
                    while True:
                        next_r = curr_r + d_r
                        next_c = curr_c + d_c
                        if 0 <= next_r < rows and 0 <= next_c < cols:
                            cell_val = grid[next_r][next_c]
                            if cell_val != color and cell_val != bg:
                                break
                            result[next_r][next_c] = color
                            curr_r, curr_c = next_r, next_c
                        else:
                            break
    return result
